public_rationale: Microsoft's reported additions challenge the implied 500MW ceiling, but the disputed disclosure does not itself establish the active-capacity measure Zitron questions. The search did not establish a comparable worldwide commissioning total. Failure to identify enough projects does not prove the ceiling, and unclear disclosure does not prove deliberate concealment.
limitations: The numerical ceiling is an implication of qualified language about personal research.
The capacity assertion and the allegation of intent cannot be settled by the same evidence.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Based on his research, Zitron cannot work out how Microsoft has brought more than 500MW of capacity online in the last year, and he thinks Microsoft is deliberately obscuring whether that capacity was contracted rather than actively in use.

statement.excerpt: I truly cannot work out how Microsoft has brought on any more than 500MW of capacity in the last year based on my research, and think Microsoft is deliberately obfuscating whether said capacity was contracted rather than actively in-use
statement.document_title: Where Are All The Data Centers?

our_interpretation: The externally checkable implication is that Microsoft added no more than 500MW of operational data-center capacity during the year ending on the post date.
Count capacity actually placed into service worldwide, including leased facilities. Do not substitute contracted power, planned campus capacity, or instantaneous electricity consumption.
His inability to reconstruct the total is a statement about his research, not itself proof of a 500MW ceiling.
The suspicion of deliberate concealment requires separate evidence of intent. Ambiguous disclosure alone cannot establish it.
criteria.support_condition: A sufficiently complete, consistently measured record establishes additions of no more than 500MW during the specified year. Supporting the deliberate-obfuscation allegation also requires evidence that Microsoft knowingly concealed or misrepresented the distinction between contracted and operational capacity.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Dated commissioning and operational records establish more than 500MW of Microsoft capacity entering service during the specified year. That would contradict the implied ceiling, without necessarily resolving the separate allegation about intent.

evidence.explanation: Microsoft reports additions exceeding the proposed annual ceiling in one quarter. However, the passage does not reconcile total capacity with capacity actually placed into service, so it is material opposing evidence without being decisive.
